title: WAMTA special issue page data (special_issue.yml)
description: Drives the per-year /special-issue page rendered by _includes/special-issue.md.

nav_hidden.description: When true, the page stays reachable but is omitted from the top navigation.

description.description: Paragraph describing the special issue, journal, and theme. Markdown allowed.

submission.description: Markdown block with submission instructions (Editorial Manager link, author guidelines, LaTeX template).

dates.description: Important dates with free-form values (allows '<del>May 30th</del> June 15th.' style markdown).

show_contact.description: When true, renders the contact-us include below the special issue content.
